purpose: Teach: 特区/能率/退席/実演/私見/既成/中長期/振替

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究特区の活用を考えろ
lines.en: Ren — think about how to use the research special zone.
lines.style: Calm, measured directive. Opens with clarity on the name. Slight weight on the verb — not asking, suggesting a path. Expectant but not harsh. The tone of someone who believes the person can do it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験の能率を上げる工夫をしております
lines.en: Yes. I'm working on ways to improve the efficiency of my experiments.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Straight posture in the voice. Not over-formal — just clear and earnest. A slight lean forward on the concrete effort he's already making.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、ゼミの途中退席は厳禁だ
lines.en: Ren — missing seminar sessions is not an option.
lines.style: Firm and direct. No negotiation in the tone. Opens with the name to establish focus. Flat, steady pace. Not angry — just non-negotiable, like stating a fact he needs to hear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で実演形式の発表を準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'm preparing a presentation with a live demonstration format for the conference.
lines.style: Responsive, showing he understood the directive. Eager but controlled. Specific about what he's doing — not vague promises. Slight quickening on the concrete action, landing steadily.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文には私見を明示しろ
lines.en: Ren — in your papers, make your own perspective clear.
lines.style: Mentor-level counsel, not command. Opens with the name. Slower pace. Weight on 「私見」equivalent — emphasizing that his voice matters. Warm underneath the directness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。既成の理論に挑戦する論文を書きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll write papers that challenge existing theory.
lines.style: Quiet confidence this time. Not defensive. He's understood the invitation beneath the instruction. Steady, even pace. Slight warmth — he's rising to meet what was asked.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、中長期の研究計画を作れ
lines.en: Ren — create a mid- to long-term research plan.
lines.style: Shift to planning-mode directiveness. Opens on the name with weight. Clear, measured pacing. Suggests scope without hovering. This is about building something sustained.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の振替手続きを学習しました
lines.en: Yes. I've learned the procedures for transferring research funds.
lines.style: Quiet close. Respectful. He's absorbed the practical step and is ready to move. No fanfare — just competent, grounded completion. Slight ease at the end, like a door softly closing on this exchange.
